scientific.integrity: The result is obtained by exact reconstruction of the first two source Apollo iterations on a scalar quadratic. Zero initialization forces the first Hessian estimate to vanish, and the second estimate simplifies to a closed-form saturating expression whose comparison with the rectification floor yields a necessary-and-sufficient activation condition.
limitations: The theorem concerns only the initialization phase through the second curvature estimate.
The objective is a deterministic scalar quadratic.
The learning rate is held constant for the theorem.
Long-run behavior and stochastic noise are not analyzed.

title: Exact second-step curvature-activation gate in Apollo
